title: Overdrive wellness upload
description: The body of POST /v1/wellness (spec §6.1, §6.2, §6.7, §8.3, ADR 0023): a batch of records the companion app read from Health Connect on the phone. Each record mirrors a Health Connect record type and carries its Health Connect id, so the same record sent twice is stored once (idempotent by source and id); a record sent again with a newer lastModified replaces the stored one. Times are UTC instants; zoneOffsetSeconds is the offset of the zone the record was written in, when Health Connect says. At most 2000 records and 4 MiB per request (413 payload_too_large). The whole batch is checked first: one bad record refuses the whole request (422 invalid_record) with the record's index and field in the message, never the value. The ranges are Health Connect's own, so a record Health Connect accepted is accepted here; implausible readings inside them are ignored when the daily figures are worked out, not refused. Rules a schema cannot state, checked by every implementation: every instant is a real date and time; end is not before start (and after start for an exerciseSession); at most 2000 records; record ids are unique inside the batch.

source.description: Where the records come from. Only Health Connect is pushed; the intervals.icu wellness is pulled by the service itself.

device.description: A name for the phone, for the service's logs. Optional.

id.description: The Health Connect record id (metadata.id): 1 to 100 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -, starting with a letter or a digit (a UUID qualifies).

instant.description: A UTC instant, ISO-8601 with a Z and up to nine fractional digits (java.time.Instant.toString).

zoneOffsetSeconds.description: Seconds the zone the record was written in is ahead of UTC (Health Connect's startZoneOffset), when known.

lastModified.description: metadata.lastModifiedTime. A record sent again with a newer one replaces the stored record; with an older or equal one it is a duplicate.

bpm.description: Beats per minute, Health Connect's range 1 to 300.

restingHeartRate.description: RestingHeartRateRecord: the resting heart rate the watch worked out, at a time.

heartRateSamples.description: HeartRateRecord: heart-rate samples between start and end (at most 20000 per record).

sleepStage.description: SleepSessionRecord.Stage, by name. awake, awake_in_bed and out_of_bed do not count as sleep.

sleepSession.description: SleepSessionRecord: a sleep session with its stages when the watch writes them.

respiratoryRate.description: RespiratoryRateRecord: breaths per minute at a time.

oxygenSaturation.description: OxygenSaturationRecord: blood-oxygen saturation in percent at a time.

steps.description: StepsRecord: steps counted between start and end.

exerciseSession.description: ExerciseSessionRecord: a workout recorded on the watch (spec §6.7). type is the exercise type as a lower-case token (biking, running, other_workout, ...): the phone maps Health Connect's constant to a name; a name the service does not know counts as a generic workout. heartRateSamples are the samples inside the session; without them the service uses the heartRateSamples records that overlap the session.

heartRateVariabilityRmssd.description: HeartRateVariabilityRmssdRecord: rMSSD in milliseconds at a time. Optional: used only where a source writes it.
